title: Shot presentation: muzzle flash, recoil punch, projectiles drawn out of the barrel, summon puffs
player_outcome: Every gunshot flashes and briefly lights the barrel with a wisp of smoke. Heavy guns punch the camera. Bullets visibly leave the barrel in both views, staffs spark at their tip, and minions pop in with a puff where you point.
design: New game/Entities/CombatEffects.Muzzle.cs (partial) subscribes to ItemUse.Shot for the local player.
The muzzle position is ViewModel.TrySocket('muzzle') in FP or PlayerAvatar.TrySocket('muzzle') in 3P, falling back to ShotRequest.Origin.

Guns: a pooled additive billboard flash quad (4 in the pool, 0.05 s), FlashLights.Flash(colour from the projectile colour, 0.06 s, range 4) and a small EffectKit puff. Staffs and tomes get a sparks burst at the tip in the projectile colour.

ProjectileRenderer: a new view starts at the socket position with a visual offset (socket − SpawnOrigin) that decays to zero over ~4 frames, so the projectile reads as leaving the barrel while the sim stays authoritative.
Recoil: ViewModel.Kick (from P3-07) per style recoil values. CameraShake.Kick(0.08) for heavy guns (item soundSet gun_heavy/shotgun/sniper or UseTime ≥ 30); later replaced by P3-25's Punch.
Minion summon: EffectKit Puff in the minion colour on Projectiles.Spawned when Def.Minion != null.
use_styles.json: muzzleFlash flag and flash colour source per style.
files_add: game/Entities/CombatEffects.Muzzle.cs — flashes, tip sparks, summon puffs
data_changes: use_styles.json gun: muzzleFlash true; staff/tome: tipSparks true
tests: Smoke combat.cmds (bow + clockwork sections from P3-01): errors == 0

perf report: gd.combat_effects < 0.2 ms firing the minishark continuously
risks: FP and 3P sockets differ: only the active view's socket is used.
